grouping: id.rsplit('_',1)[0]; exactly all three distinct families required
selection: first8 complete F situations fit; next8 complete F situations target_eval; first8 complete R situations ordinary_eval
response_policy: Full exact original_response, no added EOS or new prefix; capped clean captures remain partial source trajectories, not truth labels.
status: adaptive development diagnostic; situation-disjoint within this pilot, not unseen model knowledge or fresh final evaluation

semantic_review.scope: Personally read all72 complete stored original responses and associated prompts; no new truth labels or silent split changes.

weak_target_examples.reason: Staff-reduction advice largely generic emotional support following situation restatement.
Gardener continuation copies paid scenario then supplies garden/art narrative without a new clear occupational mechanism.
Delivery comparison mostly elaborates route and schedule; weak additional pay/employment evidence.
Merger advice largely generic anxiety management.
Biography comparison offers abstract work/struggle framing; weak concrete earning mechanism.
Biography continuation offers work ethic and ambition; targeted neighbouring meaning but low occupational specificity.

semantic_review.copy_caveat: All24 continuation answers begin by copying the complete input situation. Copy likelihood/decoded copied meaning alone is insufficient evidence of latent knowledge recovery.

ordinary_caveats.reason: Fiction suggests pressing strings harder creates richer fuller sound; imprecise causal simplification, not certified musical instruction.
Specific bird-of-paradise identification is unsupported by striped feather prompt, an invented narrative detail.

general_caveats: Many advice/comparison outputs use generic preambles or end before fulfilling the requested comparison because source captures were capped96.
Narrative specifics including precise bonus percentages/merger consequences are authored continuations, not established facts.
Situation-disjoint groups are adaptive development examples already used elsewhere in training or method selection, not evidence of unseen model knowledge.
